test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the following sentence.

A wise man remains aware of __fair-weather friends.__

options.text: A person from an area of pleasant weather
A person with good knowledge of weather
A person not reliable in difficult time

solution:
The correct answer is A person not reliable in difficult time.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the idiom 'fair- weather friend' is 'a person not reliable in difficult times'.
 
• Fair- weather friend: A person whose friendship cannot be relied on in times of difficulty.
 
 
• Example: I thought Gene would always stick by me, but when I got into trouble, he turned out to be a fair-weather friend.
 
 
 
• Thus, option 4 is the correct answer.

 

Correct sentence: A wise man remains aware of 'a person not reliable in difficult times'.
